mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic; amphotericin B causes dose-dependent renal impairment which may reduce fosfomycin clearance and increase its toxicity, while fosfomycin may exacerbate amphotericin B-induced nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN) if concurrent use is necessary; consider alternative antimicrobials; ensure adequate hydration and use amphotericin B lipid formulation if possible to minimize nephrotoxicity.
